thread:
Jen: Kicking off interleaved canary for model catalog enable: harbor-13b-v2 (quant-v2). Change window 22:00-23:00 PST tonight. Locking catalog now. @sam @anita pls ack and confirm fallback ordering.

sam: Ack. I'll watch telemetry and errors. oncall tim?

tim: I'm on for the window. watching latency and 95th. Alerting thresholds agreed?

anita: Proposed fallback order -> 1) harbor-13b-v2-quant2, 2) harbor-13b-v1-quant, 3) harbor-13b-v1 (fp16), 4) fallback-small. This keeps quant path first. Thoughts?

jen: ok. That ordering looks good. Add explicit pin for org-default route so we can roll back quickly: catalog.pin['/models/harbor/default'] = 'harbor-13b-v1'

sam: I'll stage the pin in canary -> if we need rollback we swap the pin back. Deploybot can also enforce a temp pin.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled: interleaved-canary-harbor-13b-v2 at 2026-03-21T22:00:00-08:00. Canary split: 5% global, 20% EU (test users), 0.5% internal. Health checks: latency(95)<240ms, error_rate<1.5%.

anita: Minor change: set latency guard to 250ms 3min rolling. don't want noisy blips to abort.

sam: Agreed. I'll set metric windows: latency_95 > 250ms for 3m or error_rate > 2% for 2m -> auto rollback trigger.

jen: Rollback plan: revert pin -> harbor-13b-v1, then promote quant fallback ordering to deprioritize v2. Escalation call at +15m if partial degradation.

tim: I'll keep eyes on traces and KV cache hit rate. If kv-hit drops >20% vs baseline that's a red flag.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Proactive check: infra pods pre-warmed: 120% target capacity for canary confirmed.

sam: Running a dry-run sequence now: `rbt deploy --dry-run --canary 5% --model harbor-13b-v2` -> no blocking errors.

jen: FYI release notes pasted here: https://redwood.corp/releases/harbor-13b-v2-canary. Add a short note about quant path performance and known mem regression in older drivers.

anita: Quick note on fallback tiebreaker: tie goes to lower-latency variant, not newer model. Keep that as a guardrail.

jen: Agree. Add to catalog config: `fallback_tiebreaker: latency_then_accuracy`

sam: Who's confirmed for manual rollback if deploybot doesn't auto-abort? @jen will lead, @tim will execute pin swap.

jen: Yep. I'll lead. Tim you have ops runbook link?

tim: https://redwood.corp/runbooks/model-rollback -> steps 1-6. I'll be ready to run step 3 (pin swap) if needed.

deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight passed. Lock created on catalog (lock id: 0x7f3c). To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1825000000` within 10min.

sam: adding a quick smoke prompt set in telemetry: `["What is the weather", "Summarize last meeting"]` to catch hallucinations.

jen: Perfect. If all acked, we'll start at 21:55 to allow wallets for last-minute checks.

anita: Acked.

tim: Acked. Will be oncall.

sam: Acked. Monitoring dashboards up: https://grafana/redwood/harbor-canary

jen: Thanks team. React with :rocket: when you see deploybot start. I'll post a post-mortem template if anything goes sideways.

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary started at 2026-03-21T21:55:30-08:00. Splits applied. Monitoring hooks active.

sam: saw initial churn, latency stable. KV-hit looks fine.

anita: small bump in p95 at 2m mark, within expected. no errors.

sam: 8m in: error_rate 0.4%, latency_95 = 230ms.

tim: tracing: model variant quant2 looks faster on short prompts. good.

jen: keep eyes on error spike - if any node shows >5% errors across 1m call it.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Autoscaler snapshot: GPU utilization at 42% for canary pool.

sam: 17m in: small error spike to 1.9% for 90s on EU cluster. deploybot hasn't tripped.

anita: can we temporarily reroute EU to v1-quant until we investigate? we need to lower blast radius.

jen: sam do manual route override for EU -> harbor-13b-v1-quant and raise a follow-up ticket.

sam: done: `catalog route set --region eu --model harbor-13b-v1-quant --reason \"temp EU failover\"`

deploybot: [deploybot] Route override applied by sam. Canary continues for other regions.

tim: EU error seems infra-related on 2 nodes; not model. Ops engineering looped.

sam: telemetry back to baseline after override. No broader rollback.

jen: Good call. We'll keep canary running to full hour. Post-mortem if we see pattern.

anita: once canary finishes, schedule a gradual ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 24h with pins and observed metrics.

jen: noted. I'll create the ramp plan and PR to catalog with the final fallback ordering and pin commit.

sam: closing the thread for the change window \u2014 will re-open if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
